text:
nina: Thanks for joining the runtime roadmap Q&A earlier — great turnout. Slides + perf graphs are in the shared folder: https://redwood.internal/drive/runtime-roadmap-q2 

derek: Quick summary from infra: kernel team is focusing on three parallel efforts: small-bug/perf fixes, attention fusion, and int8 inference paths. We're expecting incremental canaries starting next week for the bugfix batch.

lee: Any changes to model artifacts required for int8 or fused kernels?

derek: No model repacks needed. We might recommend a small conversion for quantization artifacts for best results, but the runtime will accept the same checkpoints. We'll document the conversion steps for teams that want maximum gains.

sara: For customers using Dedicated, how will we surface the new kernels in the Console?

nina: Plan: a toggle per pool + a "preview" rollout option. Default remains current runtime. We want to give orgs a way to simulate cost/latency before toggling.

toni: For adaptive batching defaults, can we unify across SDKs so users don't need to manually tweak? We're seeing inconsistent behavior between node/python clients.

lee: Good call. We'll add adaptive batching parameters to the SDK defaults and document override knobs. Proposed defaults we discussed in the meeting:

```
adaptiveBatching:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 30
  target_p95_ms: 150
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

lee: Console preview will show estimated token-hr cost delta over historical traffic for a chosen window.

ops-bot: Canary deployment started for kernel-bugfixes pool-3 @ 2024-11-02T11:30:00Z :rocket:

derek: FYI: initial internal benchmarks show ~20% median latency wins on 2k sequence workloads with prefix KV caching + adaptive batching enabled. Fused attention adds another ~25% in microbenchmarks but we need system-level runs.

sara: Can we get a reproducible benchmark harness? I can run Dedicated smoke tests for enterprise customers if you hand over the harness and config.

derek: Yes — uploading harness and sample configs to the infra repo by EOD. I'll ping the thread.

nina: Action items: Derek to post rollout checklist + gating thresholds by Thu; Lee to PR SDK default config and Console preview mock by next Tue; Sara to coordinate Dedicated smoke tests once harness is live; Toni to own customer comms draft. I'll compile and assign owners after lunch. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
